title: A Westfield marketing role in LA, plus three at Sol de Janeiro
intro: Monday brought something close to home: a center marketing manager seat at Westfield Topanga in Canoga Park, run by Paris-based Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. Also new to your list are three Americas marketing roles at Sol de Janeiro (part of the Provence-born L'Occitane Group) in New York, including a retail marketing job built around retailer partnerships.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Verified live Oct 19 on LinkedIn and Sol de Janeiro's Greenhouse board.

notes: Hermès Perfume & Beauty has a Marketing Executive opening in Miami ($77.7k–$88.8k), but it requires fluent English and Spanish plus 3–5 years of luxury beauty marketing, so it isn't numbered. French is listed as a plus.
Sol de Janeiro also has an Assistant Manager, Integrated Brand Media role in New York, but it asks for 4+ years in media or integrated marketing, so it isn't numbered.

L'Oréal's TikTok Shop Affiliate and TikTok Shop Content manager roles (Dermatological Beauty, NY) each ask for 4+ years of TikTok-focused experience, and Parfums Christian Dior's Manager, CRM (NY) asks for 5–7 years, so none are numbered.
SMCP Group: Greenhouse still shows only retail roles plus NY corporate finance and planning roles, with no US marketing, brand, or partnerships roles.
Pernod Ricard USA and L'Oréal USA posted no new marketing roles at your level since yesterday.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Westfield Topanga
jobs.location: Canoga Park (Los Angeles), CA, per the posting text; LinkedIn's location tag says Paramus, NJ, so confirm when you apply
jobs.work_arrangement: On site at the center (the posting describes hands-on onsite marketing and Manager-on-Duty coverage)
jobs.french_tie: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield is headquartered in Paris; Westfield is its shopping-center brand in the US.
jobs.why: An LA marketing role built on relationships: you'd run the center's digital, social, and on-site campaigns, build relationships with retailers and get them into promotions and events, and manage local community and influencer partnerships. That lines up well with your account work and event planning.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in shopping center, retail, real estate, hospitality, or related marketing roles. The posting says there's no 'perfect' candidate and encourages applying even if you don't meet every requirement.

jobs.title: Manager, Retail Marketing – Americas
jobs.posted_extra: still open; new to your list today
jobs.french_tie: Sol de Janeiro is part of L'Occitane Group (founded in Provence), and the posting says the brand has a team in Paris.
jobs.why: Retailer partnerships are the core of this job: you'd work with Sales and Key Account teams on retailer-specific campaigns, Sephora Squad influencer activations, and launch calendars across the Body, Hair, and Promo categories. It's a natural bridge from your account work.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years in marketing (beauty preferred).

jobs.title: Manager, Consumer Engagement – Americas
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days a week at the NYC HQ
jobs.posted_extra: still open; new to your list today
jobs.french_tie: Sol de Janeiro is part of L'Occitane Group (founded in Provence), and the posting says the brand has a team in Paris.
jobs.why: Experiential marketing across the Americas: consumer, influencer, and trade events for fragrance launches, plus retailer conferences and sales meetings. Your concert and event planning and your partnership skills apply directly.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–6 years of marketing experience (beauty preferred) and strong agency leadership experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Brand Marketing, Fragrance – Americas
jobs.posted_extra: still open; new to your list today
jobs.french_tie: Sol de Janeiro is part of L'Occitane Group (founded in Provence), and the posting says the brand has a team in Paris.
jobs.why: A real brand management seat on the core fragrance business: Americas go-to-market plans for launches, promotions and pricing, consumer insights, and getting ready for key retailer meetings.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years in marketing (beauty preferred), and the job is more analytical (Circana and Nielsen data, pricing).

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Field Marketing – Champagne & Sparkling (NYC)
jobs.work_arrangement: 3 days a week in the NYC office, plus in market as the business needs
jobs.french_tie: Moët Hennessy (LVMH, Paris HQ); the role runs local programming for the Champagne & Sparkling portfolio.
jobs.why: Still open, and still the best level match from this week: your sales years count toward the 3+ years.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Redken is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically, up to 25%; posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Still open, and still the most realistic-level L'Oréal role (1–3 years required).
